# ProgressCircle { #anylumino.ProgressCircle }

```python
ProgressCircle(
    value=0,
    *,
    label='',
    indeterminate=False,
    spectrum_size='m',
    **kwargs,
)
```

Display circular progress or indeterminate activity.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type     | Description                                                             | Default   |
|---------------|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value         | optional | Initial value and synced Python value.                                  | `0`       |
| label         | optional | Accessible label or visible label, depending on the component.          | `''`      |
| indeterminate | optional | Whether progress should render as an indeterminate indicator.           | `False`   |
| spectrum_size | optional | Spectrum component size such as ``'s'``, ``'m'``, ``'l'``, or ``'xl'``. | `'m'`     |
